audit.mandatory_2024_note: Child Core Set reporting, and the behavioral-health measures on the Adult Core Set, became mandatory starting with the 2024 Core Set. CMS notes this may affect comparability with earlier years because of changes in included populations and reporting methods. Treat a 2023->2024 decline for a previously inconsistent reporter as possibly a reporting-completeness effect, not a care-quality change.
criteria: The measure was publicly reported by CMS for each of the most recent three years (public reporting requires at least 25 states using Core Set specifications and meeting CMS data-quality standards).
The measure was reported by a consistent set of at least 20 states that used Core Set specifications in all three years.
The measure specifications were comparable for all three years (no specification or data-source change that would make results incomparable).
